journey.name: Structured Plan Rule Editor
journey.description: Validates that administrators can edit billing plan feature access rules through a structured editor dynamically loaded from the backend catalog, with sections for features, limits, and dashboard areas, missing-key semantics, seeded catalog protection, and JSON preview.

story.title: Structured rule editor from backend catalog
Missing key defaults and not-set semantics
Seeded plan safeguard warning and edit lock

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard and navigate to '/dashboard/billing/plans'.
Click 'Edit Plan' on a seeded plan (e.g. 'Starter' or 'Pro').
Verify the modal opens with a warning banner indicating that this plan is part of the seeded catalog and changes will be overwritten on backend restart.
Verify form rule inputs are disabled until 'Enable Editing Seeded Plan' is clicked and confirmed.
Click 'Enable Editing Seeded Plan' and verify rule inputs become interactive.
Verify rules are grouped into Features, Usage Limits, and Dashboard Areas with labels and descriptions fetched from '/v1/admin/billing/plan-rules'.
Verify each rule explains its missing key default (Features: Not included; Limits: No limit; Areas: Full control / manage) and offers a 'Not set' option.
Adjust a limit value (e.g. max products) and toggle a feature (e.g. custom domain).
Click 'Show JSON' under the debug section and verify the rendered JSON reflects the updated rule keys.
Click 'Save Plan' and verify rules are persisted.
